content.comment_body: Hello everyone! How can we configure VM variables for on/off timing using a weekly timer through the [product_name] Web Editor or another HMI interface? Thanks!

Block Type: VB, Block Format: HEX, Writable: mark the checkbox. My examples are meant to help, so please review both the [product_name] setup and the web editor configuration thoroughly.
Hi, I’m facing the same problem. Could you provide an example file? How did you set the days of the week in the [product_name] Web Editor?

analysis.insight_summary: Users want to set VM variables to control on/off timings using a weekly timer in the [product_name] Web Editor. Some confusion exists about which functions and blocks to use for proper timer setup, leading to configuration mistakes and incorrect clock behavior. The core problem is a lack of clear instructions and practical examples, especially for assigning timer variables and configuring weekdays in the web editor interface.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect a simple and effective method to configure and map VM variables for timer scheduling, including on/off times and selecting specific weekdays directly in the [product_name] Web Editor or compatible HMI. They look for clear documentation or sample configurations to assist with this common requirement.
